s1IncidentsToFile.source: All findings and AARs across M1-M27

incidents.title: Multi-agent orchestration patterns not codified in Mission Command governance
incidents.detail: 5 orchestration patterns demonstrated in 40-agent session (M9 AAR) but not codified. This session's S3 did not independently derive them despite reading the dashboard. Root cause: patterns not in governance, so they are not in context, so agents do not apply them.
incidents.suggestedResolution: FP-3 framework proposal. Codify patterns: INLINE-SYNTHESIS, S2/S3 pairing, parallel alternatives, FRAGORD (kill-and-replace), verification chain.

incidents.title: 30 files permanently lost from harvest reliability gap -- two-phase failure
incidents.detail: Phase 1: SessionEnd never fires (crash, force quit) -- harvest never runs. Phase 2: SessionEnd fires but harvest has no auto-commit -- artifacts sit untracked. Both phases caused data loss in session Z1IhGrcgGO. M7 recovered all 30 files from CC transcripts (corrective). Preventive: harvest before stale deletion + auto-commit.
incidents.suggestedResolution: Convergence rank 4 (harvest before stale deletion) + rank 5 (auto-commit harvested artifacts). Two preventive changes to harvest-session.sh.

incidents.title: Silent descoping of hard requirements is undetected by current governance
incidents.detail: M24: CORS barrier discovered. Dynamic dashboard requirement silently descended to static without surfacing. No governance mechanism detects when a hard requirement is descoped. D-SILENT-DESCOPING-PREVENTION provides the fix (hardRequirements field + executability gate).
incidents.suggestedResolution: Implement D-SILENT-DESCOPING-PREVENTION in running estimate schema. Add executability assessment gate that checks hardRequirements status changes.
